scope: Use these cases to preserve the specific behavior exposed by prior support work. This is not a claim that every historical chat was available or that every listed case now has full application coverage.
maintenance_rules: Resolve one concrete issue to its source grain, target model, failing action and expected business effect before editing the pack.
Keep the accepted baseline CSV bytes, independent answers and existing cases unchanged. Add a minimal named overlay, new delivery or separate target setup for the new issue.
Declare the expected block or final business keys and typed values independently of the implementation. Counts alone do not prove the intended relationships.

Use the normal source, mapping, preparation, approval, execution, reconciliation, durable reopen and Recipe paths that the issue actually affects. Never seed app decisions by editing repository state.

Extend only the relevant regression case and its manifest/oracle entries. Requalify the affected Odoo 19/Odoo 20, LOCAL/REMOTE and authoring/Recipe paths. Report controlled and live evidence separately.
Keep native XLSX, scale, recovery and legacy profile fixtures until their own behavior is covered; the small CSV practice pack is not evidence for those responsibilities.
The local maintenance skill may guide this process, but portable tests and canonical data must never depend on ignored .agents files.

cases.history_reference: Manufacturing practice live qualification: retained native Odoo 20 VARIANT_CODE_DIFFERED failure and independent source/raw-read audit.
cases.original_symptom: A newly created inactive Odoo 20 template retained its intended internal reference while its generated archived variant had default_code=False. Earlier inverse-link evidence could also look empty because of search_read relation formatting.
cases.source_selector_or_setup: Preserve StatusCode=20 on MA-P-0031 and MA-P-0028 in the original CSVs. The initial product phases omit active and use the normal true default. After both partitions, separate company-filtered product-status phases finalize the two inactive records.

19.setter: _set_default_code delegates to _set_product_variant_field. If no active variant is visible, the helper explicitly retries product_variant_ids with active_test=False and assigns the unique archived variant.

20.setter: _set_default_code assigns only when len(template.product_variant_ids)==1, with no archived-variant fallback. The direct inactive-create audit observed the archived variant code as False.

both.relation_formatting: search_read searches with the supplied context, then removes active_test before formatting relation values. An empty formatted product_variant_ids result alone does not prove that the archived variant is missing.

cases.expected_business_outcome: Initial state explicitly declares all 32 templates and generated variants active with matching portable references. Each status phase has 0 creates, 1 update and 27 unchanged rows, including twelve unchanged categories. The only changed field is active on the selected inactive product. Final baseline products remain unchanged, including both false active values and exact generated variant references.
cases.independent_read_boundary: Discover bounded practice templates normally; read exact reviewed template IDs with native read(active_test=False) to verify inverse links, preserve every false/zero scalar, and independently cross-check variant.product_tmpl_id. Do not infer links or substitute expected values for an actual native code=False result.
cases.required_runtime_matrix: Odoo 19 and final Odoo 20; LOCAL and REMOTE contracts; authoring and Recipe product and status phases. Record actual live modes separately.
cases.coverage_boundary: The direct inactive-create Odoo 20 result remains a retained failure. The separately declared seven-stage flow passed both live LOCAL authoring and Recipe journeys on Odoo 19 and 20, and the controlled LOCAL/REMOTE matrix; see qualification-evidence.json for exact hashes and observed versions. This establishes the staged flow, not a repaired native direct-inactive-create path. Live HTTPS REMOTE and visual browser behavior were not qualified.
